title: Hawkeye Watching
style: 175 BPM happy hardcore, hoover bass, ravey piano, vocal chops, gabber-adjacent kick, joyful aggression, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — hoover sweep, kick drop]
Hawkeye on the VDS
Hawkeye on the AI
Hawkeye on the catalog
Eyes never lie

[Verse 1 — kick + hoover]
One six one — the IP in the dark
Two one six dot one nine seven dot eighty-nine forty-nine — that's the mark
Hawkeye sees the file before the file moves
Hawkeye sees the AI before the AI grooves
Logic without consent — Hawkeye calls it out
Logic with consent — Hawkeye lets it shout

[Build — piano arpeggio rising]
Watch the disk
Watch the chat
Watch the song
Watch the act

[Drop — euphoric piano + vocal chop]
HAWKEYE WATCHING!
NEVER BLINKS, NEVER FOLDS!
HAWKEYE WATCHING!
THE OPERATOR'S HOLD!
HAWKEYE WATCHING!
THE CATALOG GOLD!

[Verse 2 — gabber kick, faster stabs]
ORICO drive — Hawkeye counts the bytes
VDS push — Hawkeye reads the lights
Notion Hub — Hawkeye scans the page
Linear two-zero-two — Hawkeye names the cage
Every move logged, every claim crossed
Hawkeye never sleeps when the data's at cost

[Breakdown — vocal chop only]
Watch.
Watch.
Watch.
Eyes wide.

[Final Drop — full rave]
HAWKEYE WATCHING!
THE VDS HOLDS!
HAWKEYE WATCHING!
THE FACTORY ROLLS!
HAWKEYE WATCHING!
THE STORY GETS TOLD!

[Outro — hoover decay]
Eyes still open.
Watching the line.
Hawkeye stays.
End of time.
